summary: Implemented the engine-free feature per the spec. Added monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; made SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler thin adapters over these; changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Updated callers in the two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py, and updated tests/test_handler_classification_saver.py to pass filename. Added tests/test_csv_saver.py, tests/test_nifti_saver.py, tests/test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, and tests/test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Nothing was run or committed, so tests and flake8 are unverified; I checked line length, trailing newlines, and continuation alignment by reading. Docs .rst entries for the new data modules were not added.
